name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 79 - Am 157
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 79 c. Recalls that the daily allowance is a flat-rate sum covering accommodation, meals and related expenses each day that a Member is present at the European Parliament on official business; stresses that Members must sign an attendance register in order to benefit from it; notes that there are exemptions for the President and the chairs of political groups who automatically benefit from it independently from their presence; calls on the European Parliament to put an end to these exceptions for the President and the chairs of political groups, who must sign an attendance register like all other Members to benefit from their per-diem;
